title: Rosemary 54 Main St Rosemary Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewGulf Views-Two-story Condo in Rosemary- Private Beach- 1 Minute Walk- 2 Bikes-Heated Pool AccessThe Space Sea The Stars – Luxury Rosemary Beach Retreat with Gulf Views! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 1-Minute Walk to the Beach – Unbeatable location in the heart of Rosemary Beach Walking Distance to Everything – Shops, dining, & entertainment just steps away Gulf Views from Private Balconies – 400 sq ft of stunning outdoor space Heated Sky Pool Access – Relax year-round in Rosemary Beach’s premier pool Spacious Open Concept Living – Stylish, professionally designed interiors Smart TVs, Apple TV & Sonos Sound System – Stay entertained in style 2 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A with ease Pet Friendly – Max 2 pets (30 lbs per dog) welcome! Fee and deposit required. Outdoor Shower on Master Suite Terrace – Perfect for post-beach refresh Keurig Coffee Maker – Start your mornings with ease 1 Designated Parking Spot – Convenient & hassle-free Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceWelcome to Sea The StarsSea The Stars is located above Cowgirl Kitchen (Cowgirl Up!) and will fit all of your vacation criteria.Sea The Stars occupies the entire 3rd and 4th floors above Cowgirl Kitchen and features over 400 sq ft of private balconies that provide spectacular Rosemary Beach views and gulf breezes.Main floor: The spacious kitchen/dining/living floor plan opens to the main floor balcony overlooking Main Street & Western Green. A King Bedroom with a shower, private balcony and the built-in bunk cubby are also on this level.Second floor: The inviting king master bedroom suite and lovely bath features an outdoor shower and sunset terrace that overlooks the homes and rooftops of Rosemary Beach.Sea The Stars will not disappoint, professionally designed by Tracery Interiors, walking distance to everything, amazing location!A Few Notes To Keep In Mind-This unit is located on the 3rd floor and there is no elevator accessHouse Rules**No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**-Rosemary Beach HOA does not allow golf carts in this community. Violators will be fined.-$150 non refundable Pet Fee and $500 refundable pet deposit required, 30 pound weight limit-max 2 dogs. Please contact our office after booking to add your pets to your reservation.-You will be required to be present at the property for any maintenance issues if you are unable to crate or contain your pet.-Walton County does not allow pets on the beach without a permit. In order to obtain a permit, you must be a Walton County resident.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (5):Main Level - Master Bedroom: King sized bed2nd Level - Master Bedroom: King sized bedMain Level - Bunk space with twin bedAREA ATTRACTIONS:Rosemary Beach is a New Urbanism community located along the Florida panhandle's scenic Route 30A between Panama City and Destin. The 107-acre, Gulf-front town was designed in 1995 to offer residents and visitors alike a sense of community, neighborhood, and convenience. Common "green" areas are located throughout Rosemary Beach and provide places for reading, games, picnics and barefoot strolls, as well as outdoor events. The fitness trail and walking tour is a 2.3-mile trail that utilizes sand paths and boardwalks to wind through the town’s native landscape, parks, and public spaces.In keeping with the town's commitment to protect the environment by not building beyond the coastal construction control line, or buffer zone, landward of the beach, nine dune walkovers have been built providing residents and guests beach access. The walkovers protect the fragile dune system and prevent erosion and washout during storms, and are unobtrusive, simple, and functional.Show less
